name: PageSmith PDF — Batch Split, Merge, Rotate, Extract & Watermark, With Re-Check Report (Local, Private)
description:
How do I split a 200-page scan pack into per-client PDF files without opening each file and clicking through it? Merging twelve statements into one. Stamping DRAFT on every page before it leaves the office. Interactive PDF tools make you open one file and click through it — and online tools make you upload legal and financial documents to someone else's server, by subscription.
PageSmith runs the page operations on whole batches, by rule, on your own computer — then RE-OPENS every output and verifies it, in writing.
WHAT IT RUNS IN ONE BATCH
• Split — by page ranges (1-3, 4-6, 7-10) or every N pages
• Merge — any number of PDFs, in the order you list them
• Rotate — all pages or a selection, 90 / 180 / 270 degrees
• Extract pages — pull pages (2, 4-5) into a new file
• Text watermark — adjustable opacity; center (diagonal), top or bottom
THE RE-CHECK REPORT (THE PART OTHER TOOLS SKIP)
After writing, every output file is re-opened and force-parsed page by page. The report confirms: the file opens, the page count matches, page conservation adds up — split parts sum back to the source, a merge equals the sum of its inputs — rotated pages really carry the new rotation, and the watermark text is really present on every page. Inputs that can't be opened (corrupt, encrypted) are listed as problems and skipped — never silently dropped, never "repaired" by guessing.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
Seeded acceptance suite (a 10-page document plus a 4-page document with a blank page and a pre-rotated page): one batch of 6 operations produced 10 outputs, 10 verified — split 3/3/4 and 4/4/2 with conservation back to 10, merge 10 + 4 = 14 with page order intact, rotate +90° landing exactly (90° on top of the pre-rotated page = 180°), extract returning exactly pages 2, 4, 5, watermark confirmed on all 10 pages. The re-check caught a deliberately truncated output, a fake PDF, and a page-count mismatch. 20 of 20 acceptance checks pass.
100% LOCAL & PRIVATE — no upload, no account, no subscription. The contracts, statements and case files stay on your machine.
Windows 10/11, no other software needed. Desktop app plus a scriptable job-file/CLI mode for repeat batches.
Scope, honestly: page operations only. PageSmith does not edit PDF content, OCR, fill forms, or repair broken PDF structure — a file that can't be opened is reported as failed, not forced.
